description: This source file implements the BlindSignAuth class, providing methods for obtaining tokens, handling HTTP responses, creating cryptographic requests, and fingerprinting public metadata within a privacy-preserving token system.

classes.name: BlindSignAuth
classes.description: Main class providing token acquisition, cryptographic request creation, response handling, and metadata fingerprinting functionalities.

methods.name: GetTokens
methods.description: Initiates the process to obtain a specified number of tokens using an OAuth token, involving network requests and cryptographic operations.

methods.name: GetInitialDataCallback
methods.description: Handles the response from the initial data request, parsing data, creating cryptographic clients, and proceeding with token signing requests.

methods.name: AuthAndSignCallback
methods.description: Processes the response from the authentication and signing request, unblinding tokens, and preparing spend token data.

methods.name: FingerprintPublicMetadata
methods.description: Generates a fingerprint hash of the public metadata for integrity verification.
